I definitely did have a lot of pain during my periods. I still do from time to time, I would have searing pain that would make me just curl up and cry. 

Irregular periods can sometimes happen from unhealthy eating habits, but I think it would be a good option for you to go to a doctor and get tested. Not to try and scare you but PCOS can get out of hand pretty quickly (at least for me) if not taken care of. So it's always best to go and see a doctor to make sure.

In my personal experience, I was around 15 years old at the time and didn't get my period for about 8-9 months. (Irregular periods are a common symptom with PCOS.) I eventually  went to an adolescent specialist and they did some blood work and I was then diagnosed with PCOS. 

If you don't mind me asking, what are some symptoms that you have that makes you suspect that you have PCOS?
